sn19.13:1.1: Idhāham āvuso Gijjhakuṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ nicchaviṃ itthiṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantiṃ || tam enaṃ gijjhā pi dhaṅkā pi kulalā pi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti vibhajenti || || Sāsudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti || || Esā bhikkhave itthi imasmiññeva Rājagahe aticārinī ahosi || || Tatiyaṃ || ||
